evidence.quote: Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis to applicants, which means that the budget available for scholarships may be used before the end of the Master's admission cycle. Due to the high volume of deserving candidates and the limited funding available for scholarships, we strongly recommend that you apply as early as possible.
Applications are available for the Fall and Spring Intakes, and cannot be considered after the application to the Master's program has been submitted.

applied.notes: Re-fetched live 2026-10-12. The overall Nova SBE Master's Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis across the Fall and Spring Intakes; there is no single fixed deadline date, so deadline_date is null. The recorded 2026-03-23 corresponds to the 'Nova SBE Continuity Scholarship' window ('Applications are open from November 13, 2025 to March 23, 2026'), which has already passed and is not the general Master's Scholarships deadline; it is replaced by the rolling-basis wording. A separate DGES scholarship (2026/27) opens 14 August but is a distinct award, not this record.

applied.notes: Re-fetched live 2026-10-12. The recorded deadline 2026-09-08 ('Extended until 8 September 2026') does not appear anywhere on the current page. ICSSR states applications are submitted online throughout the year, at least three months before the due date of the relevant conference - there is no single central fixed deadline, so deadline_date is null and the scheme is treated as rolling/year-round acceptance (status open). The 'three months before the Conference' lead time is a per-application constraint, not a dated deadline.
